parts:
What are you saying?
It's always like this.

I missed the rerun of
Wataru Seken: Demons!
Damn it!

My routine's all messed up.
Feels awful, you know?
I'm a kid at heart, too.

They're surprisingly
hard to find, huh?

Hope animal control
didn't catch him.

Don't bother.
They'll just yell at you.

No jobs lined up...
What a drag.

If it looks bad,
we run. Got it?

We were busy
hunting Gin Tama!

They went to find Gin Tama
and still aren't back.

And get her to
buy us dinner, too!

Otose's got a big heart,
even if she hides it.

Gin, another day
without work, huh?

You're a grown man!
Stop living for TV reruns!

Why am I always
in charge of meals?!

Because there's no work!
You two never do any!

If you've time for Gin Tama,
you've time to work!
So what do we do now?

Why not ask her
if she knows any jobs?

What are you guys
doing here?

What is it?
We're in a hurry.

Being forgettable
has its charms, y'know.

A Gin Tama duel?
You're on.

We're in a hurry.
Let's make this quick!

Shut up!
We're passing either way!

What do you mean
he won't see us?!

Then find a way
to see him!

And you call yourselves
Punch men?!

Gah! That natural perm
from before?!

None of your business!
Scram, you jinxes!

No idea what
you're talking about.

The Punch gang's got
a shady deal tonight!

D-don't be stupid!
This punch perm is real!

I swear to Buddha,
it's a punch perm!!

Now I'm mad!!
Get them, boys!

Hey! What's
that supposed to mean?!

If I win,
you're not getting past!

You're in the way.
Move it.

You've always been
forgettable, you know.

How dare you rub salt
in the boss's wounds!

We'll lend you
our Tama, boss.

The shady broker
won't see us.

Can't you be kind
and pretend not to notice?!

Show us how
cool you are!
I really do have it rough!

All thanks to
putting up with you!

Better forgettable
than the wig guy.

Guess one guy can
look good with a punch perm.

A Gin Tama?
Are you sure?

For your punch perm's sake,
we'll take it.

Not a wig!
A natural punch perm!

Then I'll try
pulling that perm.

I'd rather
have a sweet bun.

Boss is the world's
punch-permiest man!

Gin, let's
let him off now.

We did it!
New leading man!

Thank you,
god of punch perms!

There's no way
we can beat
a Yato!

Be a samurai!
Use your own Gin Tama
to get revenge!

You're letting
a little girl
save you?

I hate to say it,
but they're right.

You just don't
learn, do you?

We won't quit
until we win.

We won again...
It's a miracle.

I hate stubborn
people and stains.

Gin Tama aren't
meant to be sold
at huge prices.

Everyone in Edo
needs to have them.

I could get used
to that name.

I don't care
which of you I face.

Whoever it is,
make it quick!

You came out
when I called.

Why hunt a shady
Gin Tama broker?

My noble thief
dream's at stake.

Serial orb killings?
Daraku did it?

I'll do it!
Help if you want.

Yorozuya,
you're after
the broker, right?

I forgot to
wash my hands
in the bathroom.

I told you
I was persistent.

Ha ha ha!
Serves you right!

Mud that looks
like dog poop!

I'd rather get
a Game Over
than team up!

Because you
got in the way!

I helped.
Give me a reward.

That's kind of
pissing me off.

I've been chasing
Daraku all along!

Guess striking it rich
is just a dream.

Oh, Otsu's
DVD is coming out?

Kagura, don't
let him roam free.

That mayo deputy
went after him.

Then how else
do you explain it?

So much for
striking it rich.

Just bite
that guy in half.

Work your ass off
and earn some!

The Shinsengumi came.
It got messy.

The prince escaped
during the commotion.

Prince Hata
got away, after all.

Shut the hell up!
It's nighttime!

You the ones
sneaking around
here lately?

Sounds like hard work.
I'll let it slide
just this once.

I said
I'm not a kappa!

Stop!
Don't touch
my head dish!

I keep telling you,
I'm not a kappa!

I'm not a kappa!
I'll kill you!

He looks like one,
but he is no kappa
or monster.

Hey, mayo man.
Your face is twitching.

Thanks. But I've
never listened
since I was a kid.

but can I
go home now?

You're itching
for a fight, idiot!

What're you gonna
do to Ebina?

fed him
and was kind to him.

I win!
Why not set
Ebina free too?

Oh, must be fish
or some aquatic
creature...

Then Sougo,
I order you! Go!

You bastard!
I'll beat you up!

Take that mask off
and look ahead!

I didn't hit it!
I don't even wanna
touch a kappa!

It's a kappa,
just like Grandma
said!

D-Don't be stupid!
I'm not scared!

A word of advice.
Don't get mixed up
in anything weird.

Figures. Or you'd
have grown into
a better adult.

Bring it on!
You fighting or not!?

If that's a lie,
you'll pay.

Careful! It might
shoot weird beams
from its eyes!

Don't be stupid.
Anyone can see
he's a kappa.

Do what...?
Who knows if he's
a kappa or Amanto...

Toshi, say nothing.
We saw nothing.

I hate taking
orders like that
from Hijikata.

A kappa's weak spot
is its head dish!

It's violent.
Can't let it go.

Even with your
guarantee, boss,
this one's a no.

That idiot
just lost track
of him, I bet.

We worked hard
to find them!

No such thing
as easy money, huh?

Either way,
he's in jail now.

He was furious
about being
mistreated.

Damn...
At a time like this...

We're called out
every single time.

It's a pain
in the ass.

Damn it.
What a pointless fight.

You'll pay.
I'll win it back.

Sougo!
Take that
sleep mask off!

We can't wait!
Our lives
are at stake!

You just wanna
see that woman!

A government VIP
is coming shortly.

Even if it's a pain,
don't say so.

and peace
in Edo to protect.

We'll do it!
Please let us!

Yeah! Lend them!
I'll fight you!

You won't tell
anyone I lost, right?

Hope we can
find them with
enough men...

Dreams?
What other dreams
are there!?

The princess
has a job for us.

Better than
slicing each other up.

It's seven at night.
What a pain.

Hijikata lost.
From now on,
I'm the deputy.

Good things come
to those who sleep.

My apologies
for the late hour.

Not at all.
I impose on you.

I see...
Then it cannot
be helped...
